rewrites.//: Proxy the API through this origin. The browser only ever talks to the Vercel domain, so CORS never applies and the JWT is never sent cross-origin. Replace the host with your Render service URL.
SPA fallback. Without it, loading /inventory directly returns 404 because no such file exists; the router only works after index.html has booted.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints asset filenames, so a changed file gets a new name and this can be cached indefinitely.
